text.tspan: source :>> source = "INC-AEBS-010 increment framing; GCP AAOS runtime proof environment"
"Stakeholder-visible AEBS behavior must be reviewable on a real AAOS display, not a host substitute."

Systems engineers and reviewers need live AEBS threat and intervention state visible on an actual AAOS SDV display so that stakeholder-visible AEBS behavior can be reviewed without a host-side substitute.
rationale :>> rationale = "Displayed values must remain traceable to their source identity and context."

Systems engineers need source provenance, units, coordinate frame, timestamps, rate and freshness, validity, and bounded displayed cardinality preserved between native Autoware output, DE4SDV AEBS coordination state, and display-derived presentation.
rationale :>> rationale = "A lost or invalid source must never be misread as current AEBS state."
Systems engineers and maintainers need stale, unavailable, invalid, and restored display behavior so that a lost or invalid source cannot be misread as current AEBS state.
rationale :>> rationale = "Verification needs source-to-screen correlation and replayable evidence."
Verification engineers need source-to-screen correlation and replayable evidence so that displayed states can be traced to observed source events.
rationale :>> rationale = "Visualization instrumentation must not influence the behavior it observes."
Maintainers and verification engineers need assurance that visualization instrumentation cannot command or modify AEBS detection, warning, intervention, or release behavior.
REQ-AEBS-S2-002 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-009 and N-AEBS-010.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-009 and N-AEBS-010"
rationale :>> rationale = "Preserves provenance for each displayed value."
The visualization test system shall preserve source identity, timestamp, units, coordinate frame, freshness, validity, and bounded cardinality for each displayed AEBS value or state.
REQ-AEBS-S2-003 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-009.
rationale :>> rationale = "Anchors the display to the pinned native Autoware AEB component."
The visualization test system shall consume live output from the pinned native Autoware AEB component: RSS threshold data and the exact native intervention diagnostic.
REQ-AEBS-S2-014 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-010.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-010; success criteria formerly AC-AEBS-S2-004"
rationale :>> rationale = "Coordinator-derived values must not masquerade as native Autoware output."
"Met when no retained frame or user-interface dump presents a coordinator-derived distance value as native Autoware output."
The visualization test system shall not present coordinator-derived distance values as native Autoware output.
REQ-AEBS-S2-004 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-009.
rationale :>> rationale = "Displays the DE4SDV coordinator's own warning, braking, and lifecycle state."
The visualization test system shall consume live DE4SDV AEBS warning request, braking request, and intervention lifecycle state from the existing AEBS coordinator.
REQ-AEBS-S2-005 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-013.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-013; success criteria formerly AC-AEBS-S2-003"
rationale :>> rationale = "No command path from instrumentation into AEBS or vehicle control."
"Met when the visualization test system publishes nothing to the vehicle runtime and issues no vehicle command."
The visualization test system shall expose no command path from display, bridge, or transport into Autoware, the AEBS coordinator, or vehicle control.
REQ-AEBS-S2-006 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-011.
rationale :>> rationale = "Stale input must suppress threat geometry rather than display it."
When no valid frame is accepted for the selected bounded timeout, the visualization test system shall suppress threat geometry and present an explicit stale disposition.
REQ-AEBS-S2-007 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-011.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-011; success criteria formerly AC-AEBS-S2-006"
rationale :>> rationale = "Unavailable sources need an explicit disposition, not silence."

"Met when, under deterministic closed-loop frame injection, the unavailable disposition is rendered with live geometry cleared and the health chip identifying the degraded condition whenever no visualization source or service is available or no valid frame has yet arrived."
When no visualization source or service is available, or before the first valid frame arrives, the visualization test system shall present an explicit unavailable disposition.
REQ-AEBS-S2-008 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-011.
rationale :>> rationale = "Malformed frames must be rejected without displaying payload values."
The visualization test system shall reject unsupported schema, malformed, non-finite, out-of-range, stale-timestamp, and non-monotonic frames without displaying their payload values.
REQ-AEBS-S2-009 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-011.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-011; success criteria formerly AC-AEBS-S2-007"
rationale :>> rationale = "Recovery must be bounded and observable without application restart."

"Met when a retained run shows that, after each failure disposition, the restored indication appears once the consecutive-valid-frame count bound as AO-AEBS-010-006 is reached, stays for the selected bounded duration, and the same application process runs throughout."
After a failure disposition, the visualization test system shall present a bounded restored indication after the selected consecutive-valid-frame criterion is met, without application restart.
REQ-AEBS-S2-010 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-009 and N-AEBS-012.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-009 and N-AEBS-012; success criteria formerly AC-AEBS-S2-002"
rationale :>> rationale = "The rendering surface must be the real AAOS guest application."

"Met when one uninterrupted real-time take of the native application in the booted display-capable AAOS SDV guest presents the reducer-driven MONITORING, WARNING, INTERVENTION, and RELEASED dispositions from accepted frames, the release disposition is accompanied by a verified zero-speed stop observation, and no edited or older-generation footage is presented as part of the take."
The visualization test system shall render AEBS state in a native application inside a booted display-capable AAOS SDV guest.
REQ-AEBS-S2-012 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-009.
rationale :>> rationale = "Runtime environment evidence must come from the same rendered session."

While AEBS state is rendered, the visualization test system shall observe the AAOS SDV guest package manager, system server, display composition, vehicle service, and SDV gateway within the same rendered session.
REQ-AEBS-S2-013 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-009.
rationale :>> rationale = "A host-side browser page is not the AAOS rendering surface the need demands."
The visualization test system shall not use a host-side browser page as the AEBS rendering surface.
REQ-AEBS-S2-011 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-012.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-012; success criteria formerly AC-AEBS-S2-001"
rationale :>> rationale = "Each rendered state must be correlatable with its observed source event."

"Met when the verification take holds source, transport, ingress, and guest identity, sequence, timestamp, log, and guest-native capture records for each rendered state, each rendered state is correlated with its observed source event, and the accepted callbacks are consecutive with zero sequence gaps over the verification take."

The visualization test system shall retain source, transport, ingress, and guest identity, sequence, timestamp, log, and guest-native capture records for each rendered state so that each rendered state can be correlated with its observed source event.
REQ-AEBS-S2-015 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-013.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-013; obligation formerly stated in AC-AEBS-S2-003"
"Disclosing the read-only boundary in every session supports the non-interference assurance that maintainers and verification engineers need."

"Met when, for each retained rendered session, at least one retained screen capture or user-interface dump of that session shows the read-only engineering-visualization boundary statement on the rendered display; either artifact suffices."
The visualization test system shall state the read-only engineering-visualization boundary on its rendered display in every rendered session.
REQ-AEBS-S2-016 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-010.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-010; obligation formerly stated in AC-AEBS-S2-004"
rationale :>> rationale = "Displayed obstacle geometry must keep one identified source."

"Met when inspection of the source adapter's subscriptions shows the native Autoware filtered obstacle point cloud as the only input of the obstacle geometry projection, and each retained frame record marks its obstacle geometry as display-derived."
The visualization test system shall render display-derived obstacle geometry only from the native Autoware filtered obstacle point cloud.
REQ-AEBS-S2-017 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-010.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-010; obligation formerly stated in AC-AEBS-S2-004"
rationale :>> rationale = "Display-derived values must not masquerade as native Autoware decision metrics."
"Met when no retained screen capture and no retained user-interface dump presents a display-derived scalar as a native Autoware decision metric."
The visualization test system shall not present any display-derived scalar as a native Autoware decision metric.

REQ-AEBS-S2-018 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-010. Reworded for owner review to the HMI contract (VISUALIZATION-CONTRACT.md section 13.4), which removed the former "AEB decision distances not visualized" row on purpose; the earlier wording required that row. Labeling the displayed obstacle range as derived from the filtered point cloud is the design means of REQ-AEBS-S2-017 and needs no requirement of its own.
"Derived from N-AEBS-010; obligation formerly stated in AC-AEBS-S2-004; reworded to VISUALIZATION-CONTRACT.md section 13.4"
rationale :>> rationale = "Viewers must not infer native AEB decision distances from the display."
"Met when no retained screen capture and no retained user-interface dump of the rendered display presents a native AEB decision distance."
The visualization test system shall present no native AEB decision distance on its rendered display.
REQ-AEBS-S2-019 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-011.
"Derived from N-AEBS-011; obligation formerly stated in AC-AEBS-S2-005; success criteria formerly AC-AEBS-S2-005"
rationale :>> rationale = "Expired obstacle geometry must not be displayed as current while other fields stay live."

"Met when the verification take shows the obstacle range, bearing, and points cleared within the receipt-based staleness bound after the filtered obstacle-cloud source stops updating, while the accepted frame sequence continues."

When no filtered obstacle-cloud update has been received within the selected receipt-based staleness bound, the visualization test system shall suppress the display-derived obstacle geometry, including while accepted live frames continue.
REQ-AEBS-S2-020 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-011.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-011; obligation formerly stated in AC-AEBS-S2-005"
rationale :>> rationale = "Synthesized values would let a lost source be misread as current AEBS state."

"Met when, for each period in which a retained bridge receipt record of the filtered obstacle cloud shows no update within the selected receipt-based staleness bound, the retained frame log of the same run shows no interpolated, smoothed, or predicted obstacle value in place of the missing fresh data."

When no filtered obstacle-cloud update has been received within the selected receipt-based staleness bound, the visualization test system shall not substitute interpolated, smoothed, or predicted values for the missing fresh data.
REQ-AEBS-S2-021 System 2 candidate derived from N-AEBS-011.
source :>> source = "Derived from N-AEBS-011; obligation formerly stated in AC-AEBS-S2-006"
rationale :>> rationale = "A degraded disposition must stay recognizable without relying on color alone."
"Met when each degraded disposition shown in any retained screen capture or user-interface dump carries a cue other than color."
The visualization test system shall not use color as the sole cue of a rendered degraded disposition.
